QuestInfo.name: A Difficult Decision
QuestInfo.0: Lady Syl was dazed when she learned the truth. You wonder what decision she'll make now.
QuestInfo.1: Lady Syl has decided to make amends with the Dark Lord, but first, she wants him to demonstrate that he is not a weakling. She seemed to grow more confident when she said that. #bGo meet the Dark Lord in the Jazz Bar#k.
QuestInfo.2: The Dark Lord apologized for keeping the truth hidden all this time.  He acknowledges Dual Blades as a branch of the Thieves and says he will fight at their side.

1.0: All right, all right! I surrender. You win. The Dual Blades have proven their power, and Lady Syl has shown the strength of her will. Ha, Syl hasn't changed a bit. I'm glad.
1.1: As of this moment, I officially recognize and embrace the lost art of dual-wielding. The Dual Blades are welcomed back into the Thieves' fold.
1.2: Thieves and Dual Blades, we are united once more! I know it won't be easy. We've been divided for so long. Perhaps the first step is for me to seek out Syl and apologize in person...
1.3: In any case, I am happy to fight at your side, #h0#. I know you're responsible for this reconciliation. Thank you. I will help you in your next Job Advancement.

npc.0: Meet the Dark Lord at the Jazz Bar. You know what to do...

mob.0: Ha! You're no match for me.
